programme.desc: Jovy suffers a minor injury from a traffic accident.

programme.title: Rosy Business
programme.desc: The Prince delivers a batch of royal rice to Wuxi while being under seige by famine victims.

programme.title: Unchained Medley
programme.desc: Man-man knows how Yeuk-lam feels about Chi-kit, so she wants to play matchmaker for the duo.

programme.title: Unchained Medley
programme.desc: Ho-tung and Man-man pretend to argue, causing Suet-hoi to give in and encourage Ho-tung to shoot clips of the opera troupe for promotion.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: Suet doesn't want to take everything for granted and she voluntarily asks to work in Wu Kin's salt store.

programme.title: Darkside Of The Moon
programme.desc: Experience the pinnacle of Chinese drama with TVB Pearl Drama Channel, showcasing the best of kung fu, drama, period pieces, action, and romance. Embrace the finest of each genre, your ultimate destination for exceptional Chinese drama.

programme.title: Undertaker For Life!
programme.desc: Undertakers are anything but gloomy; they’re funny, generous and dedicated. We would gladly go on vacation with them, but sadly, they never have any dead time.

programme.title: First Stories - Two Spirited
programme.desc: This short documentary presents the empowering story of Rodney "Geeyo" Poucette's struggle against prejudice in the Indigenous community as a two spirited person (gay, lesbian, bisexual, and transgender).

programme.title: How They Saw Us Proudly She Marches
programme.desc: A recruitment film made in 1943. Its words offer women the excitement and challenge of new kinds of work in the armed services. The visual message, however, suggests that this work is merely temporary and possibly even unnatural for women.

programme.title: The Street
programme.desc: A poignant adaptation of Mordecai Richler's short story candidly depicts families' responses to aging members. Through watercolor and ink, the filmmaker captures raw family emotions, reflecting harsh realities.

programme.title: Some American Feminists
programme.desc: A series of interviews, interspersed with newsreel footage, places the American feminist movement in a historical perspective. Six of the women who gave impetus to the movement discuss those issues that most concern them and which are still being debated.

programme.title: Canada Vignettes Log Drivers Waltz
programme.desc: A young girl who loves to dance and is ready to marry chooses a log driver over his more well-to-do, land-loving competition. Driving logs down the river has made him the best dancing partner to be found.

programme.title: Yul 871
programme.desc: A Paris engineer on Flight YUL 871 to Montréal seeks his displaced parents amid the restlessness of the era. Amidst a brief love affair and Expo visits, he finds connection with a little girl.

programme.title: Perfecting The Art Of Longing
programme.desc: Using footage from security cameras, video calls and home-video archives, this experimental short film leads us on a journey through memory, family and faith, exploring the nature of connection and distance.

programme.title: Sun Wind And Wood
programme.desc: People combat high energy costs with inventive solar, wind, and wood solutions. This film showcases experiments like the Ark, a bio-shelter sustaining a family with housing, heat, food, and electricity using natural systems.

programme.title: Ninja Warrior UK
programme.desc: Ben Shephard, Rochelle Humes and Chris Kamara host the final of the assault course game show. Who will conquer Mount Midoriyama and be crowned the UK's first Ninja Warrior?

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Teams in the first week of qualifications are led by Joe Moravsky and Jessie Graf.

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The NorCal Ninjas, led by team captain David Campbell, take on formidable foes featuring Ian Dory and Meagan Martin.

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Brent Steffensen and Kacy Catanzaro lead Team Alpha; Kevin Bull serves as captain of the Expendabulls; other competitors include Ryan Stratis and his team, Stratisfaction, and Tremayne Dortch and the Tre Amigoz.

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Competitors include Flip Rodriguez and Team Ronin, Lance Pekus and the Wild Bunch, Noah Kaufmann and the Think Tank, and Karson Voiles and Karsonic Boom.

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Geoff Britten captains the Ninja Brittens; Michelle Warnky and brothers Chris and Brian Wilczewski comprise the Lab Rats; Elet Hall captains the Elet-Tricks; Daniel Gil leads the Iron Grips.
